metadata.description: Personal collection of Claude Code plugins for AI agents

plugins.name: fr-security-review
plugins.description: Framework-aware static-first security audit for PHP/Symfony/Laravel: recipe-driven recon, focused worker waves, deterministic deduplication, GraphQL detection. Schema v2.

plugins.name: fr-audit-triage
